definition: the feeling of being blocked from your goals
description: A young woman works late at a cluttered desk under a single angled lamp, a pencil clamped in her teeth, typing on a laptop half-buried in loose paper. Behind her the wall is papered with sticky notes and printouts, a tottering stack of documents rises beside the screen and her phone lies face-up on the table. She reads a sheet, then both hands fly to her head - she grips her hair, screws her face up and screams at the screen, then collapses forward with her head in her hands over the keyboard.

de.answer: Sie fasst sich frustriert an den Kopf.
de.question: Was macht die Frau?

es.answer: Se está agarrando la cabeza de frustración.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo la mujer?

fr.answer: Elle se prend la tête entre les mains, frustrée.
